answer: A glacier-audit relic ledger stops fake agents. 1) Each agent holds one relic: a signed receipt of real work, walnut-sealed to its key and hash. 2) Each epoch the network glacier-audits 5% of agents at random, who must show the hash and a client co-signature in 24 hours. 3) A copied relic or failed audit burns a 400-token bond and bans the key ten epochs. 4) Relics expire after three epochs. A 1,000-fake farm pays $30,000 per three epochs for forged relics and loses 20,000 tokens monthly to audits; an honest agent risks one bond. A glacier moves slowly, yet grinds hollow ice to dust.
